from pathlib import Path
p = Path('src/lib/OpenEXRUtil/ImfCheckFile.cpp')
text = p.read_text(errors='replace')
# Patch only inside readCoreScanlinePart: change a few 'if (reduceTime) break;' to set rv success
# We'll do targeted replacements around that function.
start = text.find('bool\nreadCoreScanlinePart')
end = text.find('////////////////////////////////////////', start)
if start==-1 or end==-1:
    raise SystemExit('could not locate readCoreScanlinePart block')
blk = text[start:end]
orig = '            if (reduceTime) break;'
repl = '            if (reduceTime) { rv = EXR_ERR_SUCCESS; break; }'
blk2 = blk.replace(orig, repl)
# also handle the later break on decoding_run failure: 'if (reduceTime) break;' with different indentation
orig2 = '                if (reduceTime) break;'
repl2 = '                if (reduceTime) { rv = EXR_ERR_SUCCESS; break; }'
blk2 = blk2.replace(orig2, repl2)
# and update fail case
orig3 = '                if (reduceTime) break;'
# already replaced by above

if blk2 == blk:
    print('warning: no changes made in block (patterns not found)')
text2 = text[:start] + blk2 + text[end:]
p.write_text(text2)
print('patched', p)
